_source: Written by the doc-generator each run from the Airtable Components table, per .claude/skills/astro-page/SKILL.md. Component name, status, verdict and shipped version only — NEVER an Airtable record id, which is a local decision (.claude/registry.local.json, gitignored) and must not reach the repo or a public page.
_shipped_in: Derived, not read from a column: the board has no field for the version a component shipped in. v0.1.0 is the only tag in the repository, and src/index.ts at that tag exports all ten public components, so every one of them shipped in 0.1.0. A component with no public export has null here.
_development_is_derived: `Development` is an Airtable formula. It is reproduced here as read, never written — the way to change it is to change the evidence underneath it.

cardLayoutVertical._note: No row exists in the Components table for this layout. It is a card sub-component in Figma and has no registry row of its own, so it has no status to show — that is a gap in the board, not a failed read.
